turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got a bonus at work and I'm trying to decide what to do with it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is paying off my credit card, which has a pretty high interest rate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's putting it in a savings account as an emergency fund, since I don't really have one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is investing it in an index fund for the long term.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is taking a trip I've wanted to do for years.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The credit card with a high interest rate is usually the first thing to tackle, since that interest costs you every month. Building an emergency fund is a close second. The index fund is great for the long term, but it makes more sense once the card is paid off.
